title: Financial Toxicity in Patients With Early-stage Breast Cancer
official: Assessing Prevalence of Financial Burden and Impact of Cancer on Financial toxicIty in Patients With Early-stage Breast Cancer
summary: Non-profit, multicenter, prospective, observational study. This study aims to evaluate whether the articulated treatment algorithm that is now possible for early-stage breast cancer patients does produce tangible changes of financial distress over the time and whether the determinants of financial distress change their relative weight over the time.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent form
* Age \> 18 years at the time of study entry
* Histologically confirmed stage I-III invasive breast carcinoma before starting any systemic treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Stage IV invasive breast carcinoma
* Major cognitive dysfunction or psychiatric disorders
* Any previous systemic treatment for the current breast cancer
